rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for saying something from memory, especially a memorized passage or poem.

example.english: I often had to recite Tang poems when I was little.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 jiu3 bui3 tong4 si1

rows.note: Use this for formally or performatively reciting a poem or passage aloud to an audience.

example.english: At tomorrow's gala, I will recite this poem aloud.
example.traditional: 聽日個晚會，我會朗誦呢首詩。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 go3 maan5 wui2 ngo5 wui5 long5 zung6 ni1 sau2 si1

rows.note: Use this more formal term when emphasizing that the passage has been memorized and is being recited.

example.english: Before the exam, students have to recite the assigned passage from memory.
example.traditional: 考試前，學生要背誦指定課文。
example.jyutping: haau2 si5 cin4 hok6 saang1 jiu3 bui3 zung6 zi2 ding6 fo3 man4

rows.note: Use this when the speaker is reading the text aloud from the page rather than relying entirely on memory.

example.english: Could you recite the passage on this sheet aloud for me?
example.traditional: 你幫我讀出張紙上面嗰段。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 duk6 ceot1 zoeng1 zi2 soeng6 min6 go2 dyun6
